label: Mind-independence internal controls and parked ontic declaration
summary: Declaration audit on main 79cedbb1f: internal counterfactual assertion, attitude-judged legitimacy and truth are distinct obligations. Added a finite explicit-profile candidate and separation controls: actual truth and an inhabited changed-attitude alternative accompany internally licensed assertion of a false counterfactual; a stably true candidate need not be accepted. This does not encode the quasi-realist aim as successful vindication. Original MIND_INDEPENDENT_1 allowance remains open because the profile-selection interpretation is not yet the original counterfactual semantics. Ontic MIND_INDEPENDENT_2 is parked pending owner selection: truth invariance under attitude interventions, absence of grounding in attitudes, or distinct sibling interpretations. Neither a free MoralFact/Independent predicate nor a no-grounding flag completes that meaning. Actual-stable calibration and invariance-only are rejected substitutions for ontic independence; minimal truthaptness is not robust facthood. Reused OBJECTIVE-TRUTH-DEFINITION-CONTROLS and POE-EXTERNAL-TRUTH-TO-OBJECTIVE-BRIDGE only for their exact finite/calibrated meanings, not as mind-independence certificates. Noncognitivism's taxonomy licenses neither rejection of the internal sentence nor a false-to-facthood inference. Root connection target: STMT-GOODNESS-APPROVAL-ACCOUNT-FAILS (50d8be94-f9c1-52af-bf43-fb2751915756), leading via goodness/form-end to the Catholicism root. Rejected direct bridge from internal acceptance separation to that premise; no form/end goodness identity or named approval account failure follows. The external evil objective-classifier result is likewise not itself a root connection or a defeat of internal critique. No coverage/exclusivity of worldviews or universal standpoint adequacy assumed. Both original sense allowances preserved; no premise discharge.

Ontic: owner to select invariance, grounding-independence, or sibling accounts; then encode moral facthood and the selected relation with explicit bridges. Root: connect that selected account to form/end goodness and the named approval account before claiming progress on the case. Next independent slice: encode the internal sentence selection/attitude-policy semantics, comparing alternative policies without asserting their adequacy.
